Tests that streaming requests bypass cache entirely

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClientFromJson } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClientFromJson("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}");
  const result = await client.chatStream({ messages: [{ content: "Hello", role: "user" }], model: "gpt-4" });
  for await (const resultChunk of result) {
    console.log(resultChunk);
  }
}

void main();
```
